value.rationale: The second power of a cycle is a canonical neighbor-distance family. Its degree-one induced-subgraph complex has a mathematically motivated but previously unresolved universal nonvanishing question: all n>=5 are rationally nonacyclic, the sign changes only at n=9, and the total reduced rational Betti number has a proven exponential lower growth rate. These structural infinite-family statements are not a finite table or trivial normalization.
